raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "qcs-api-client-common" %}
{% set version = "0.21.0" %}

package:
  name: qcs-api-client-common-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rigetti/qcs-api-client-rust/archive/refs/tags/common/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 18872a67a5a6a21db8ec921b8bcf2c37543b177db94299d383fd02536bddf961

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ compiler('rust') }}
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}  # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0  # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - pkg-config
    - python  # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0
    - openssl
    - python

outputs:
  - name: qcs_api_client_common
    requirements:
      host:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("qcs-api-client-common", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("qcs-api-client-common", exact=True) }}
    test:
      imports:
        - qcs_api_client_common
      requires:
        - pip
      commands:
        - pip check

  - name: qcs-api-client-common
    script: install.sh  # [unix]
    script: install.bat  # [win]
    build:
      ignore_run_exports:
        - python
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}  # [build_platform != target_platform]
        - python  # [build_platform != target_platform]
      host:
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
      run:
        - grpcio >=1.63.0
        - grpc-interceptor >=0.15.0
        - httpx >=0.27.0
        - openssl
        - python
    test:
      imports:
        - qcs_api_client_common
      requires:
        - pip
        - protobuf
        - pytest >=8.1.1
        - pytest-asyncio >=0.23.6
        - pytest-mock >=3.14.0
        - python
        - syrupy >=4.0.0
      source_files:
        - qcs-api-client-common/tests
        - qcs-api-client-common/tests_py
      commands:
        - pip check
        # `test_sync_method_from_async_context` and `test_refresh_interceptor` call
        # `ClientConfiguration.load_default()` without one of the `monkeypatch` fixtures,
        # so they fall back to `~/.qcs/settings.toml`, which does not exist on the build
        # workers. Point them at the fixtures shipped in the tarball instead; the tests
        # that need a different configuration set these variables themselves.
        - cd qcs-api-client-common
        - export QCS_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH=tests_py/fixtures/settings.toml  # [unix]
        - export QCS_SECRETS_FILE_PATH=tests_py/fixtures/secrets.toml  # [unix]
        - set "QCS_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH=tests_py\fixtures\settings.toml"  # [win]
        - set "QCS_SECRETS_FILE_PATH=tests_py\fixtures\secrets.toml"  # [win]
        - pytest -v  # [not win]
        # `test_default` and `test_load_profile` compare against syrupy snapshots that
        # embed the fixture paths with forward slashes, while `fixture_env` builds them
        # with `pathlib`, so on Windows they compare `tests_py\\fixtures\\settings.toml`
        # against `tests_py/fixtures/settings.toml` and can never match. Upstream test
        # bug rather than a packaging problem; the other 17 tests do run on Windows.
        - pytest -v --deselect tests_py/test_configuration.py::TestClientConfiguration::test_default --deselect tests_py/test_configuration.py::TestClientConfiguration::test_load_profile  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/rigetti/qcs-api-client-rust
  summary: 'Rust clients for Rigetti APIs'
  description: |
    Provides structures common to the gRPC and OpenAPI clients. In particular, it provides
    a ClientConfiguration type which is used to configure the clients using local QCS settings.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - BastianZim
    - MementoRC
  feedstock-name: qcs-api-client-common
